pull-orange-locks.summary: Pull long ginger locks down the whole coat and the fringe over the eyes.
pull-orange-locks.tip: Start each lock high and pull it down the way the hair hangs: over the eyes on the fringe, and down the body to the ragged ends at the bottom. Leave thin dark gaps of the earlier coat showing between the locks so the coat reads as separate strands, as the after picture shows. Keep the face plain for now; the nose comes later.
paint_notes: Rust brown only comes close to the ginger in the after picture, which is a little lighter and more orange; keep the strokes thin so the darker coat under them still shows in the gaps.

lines.7: Press the full width of the brush at the top of each lock, then turn onto its edge and lighten the pressure as you pull down the way the hair hangs.

pull-gold-locks.summary: Pull a few honey-gold locks on the fringe and the sunlit side of the coat.
pull-gold-locks.tip: The light comes from the right, so put these locks where it catches the hair: on the fringe and down the right side of the coat, with most of them on the right side of the shaggy coat. Pull each one down over a ginger lock from step 14, keeping them few and thin. The after picture also has one small Honey gold dab in the meadow, its middle about 11 1/4 in from the left edge; add it there.

lines.10: Leave the ginger locks from step 14 and their dark gaps showing around these marks, as in the after picture.
